subject: science
concept: Classifying chemical reactions: synthesis, decomposition, single replacement, double replacement
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Chemical Reactions) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models each reaction type using physical molecule pieces combining or separating
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described chemical equation to its correct reaction type category
exercise.abstract: Student classifies a given chemical equation as synthesis, decomposition, single, or double replacement

misconception_flags: confuses single replacement (one element swaps) with double replacement (two elements swap)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
